description: A nonempty first-order structure models \(\operatorname{Cn}(T)\) if and only if it models \(T\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.model_closure.{u, v, u_1} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (T : L.Theory) (M : Type u_1)
  [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] : M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.consequenceClosure T ↔ M ⊨ T
